rollback_preconditions: Obtain approval for the exact physical canary and rollback action.

Generate a fresh custodial-rollback-readiness.v2 receipt from the installed candidate and require eligible=true, rollback_fence_active=true, an exact rollback_fence_id, and every required count equal to zero.
Freeze the exact rollback receipt and manager/backend evidence before changing the APK.
Keep the durable native rollback fence active until the approved downgrade completes; clear it with the exact receipt fence ID only when aborting the rollback.
Verify package, version, signer, byte count, and APK SHA-256 before installation.
Confirm the queue is rollback-compatible IndexedDB v4 and newer authority records are replay-fenced.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not run the downgrade command without a fresh eligible rollback-readiness receipt.
Do not clear the receipt-bound native rollback fence before the approved downgrade.
Do not bypass package or signer mismatch.
Do not resume fleet traffic from a source-only or emulator-only result.
